header.keyword: Advent: Death Dragon & Cost 5 or more
header.cleanBody:
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

After your [Accel] effect resolves, you can stack this Spirit card from the Hand onto your Spirits via [Advent].
